note: A manuscript scene, under `10 Manuscript/<book>/`. Facts live in frontmatter; the prose is the body. Machine source: this schema. Scenes are the notes the reference panel follows: their relation fields (`pov`, `characters`, `location`, `plotlines`) drive which canon entities the panel surfaces.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Fixed classifier — always `scene`. Set by the template; do not change it.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Text. The scene's title. Should match the note title.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.description: Text. A short logline for the scene.

fields.name: book
fields.description: A single `[[Book note]]` link (in `20 Planning/`). Which book the scene belongs to.

fields.name: act
fields.description: Number. The act this scene sits in.

fields.name: chapter
fields.description: Text. The chapter label (kept as text to allow "1a", "Prologue", etc.).

fields.name: order
fields.description: Number. The scene's order within the book — the primary reading-order sort key. Distinct from the manuscript order Longform maintains, and from chronology (`storyDay`).

fields.name: storyDay
fields.description: Number. The ordinal day the scene happens on in the story (Day 1 = 1). This drives timeline placement and chronological sort; a relative jump is authored as `prev + 14` ("two weeks later"). Works without any calendar. Timeline falls back to `order` when `storyDay` is empty.

fields.name: when
fields.description: Text. A free-text display label for the scene's time — "Day 1", "Two weeks later", or a date. Shown on the timeline; does not affect placement (that's `storyDay`). A calendar-aware absolute date (`storyDate`, Calendarium, two-calendar-capable) is a planned optional addition — not part of the schema yet.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Select — one of `idea | outline | draft | revised | done | final`. Drafting progress; drives board columns and stats.

fields.name: pov
fields.description: A single `[[Character]]` link — the point-of-view character. A typed relation the panel highlights.

fields.name: characters
fields.description: List of `[[Character]]` links present in the scene. The reference panel resolves these to the Characters-in-scene view.

fields.name: location
fields.description: A single `[[Location]]` link — where the scene takes place.

fields.name: plotlines
fields.description: List of `[[plotline]]` links (in `20 Planning/`). Which story arcs this scene advances; drives the Plotlines view.

fields.name: arc
fields.description: Text. The character/story arc this scene advances (free text note, not a link).

fields.name: beat
fields.description: Text — a `[[beat note]]` link in `20 Planning/`, or empty. The planning beat this scene realises.

fields.name: wordcount
fields.description: Number. Maintained by the word-count plugin; leave empty and let it fill in.

fields.name: prev
fields.description: List of `[[scene]]` links to the preceding scene(s) — the reading-order chain to the neighbouring scene. Fragile versus Longform's own ordering; provisional.

fields.name: next
fields.description: List of `[[scene]]` links to the following scene(s) — the reading-order chain to the neighbouring scene.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Text. Free-form author notes about the scene — scratch/annotations, working reminders. Not story prose.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Text. The series this scene belongs to.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: List. Always includes `manuscript/scene` — how views and Bases select scene notes.
